mapper.select: select notification_id, recipient_id, sender_id, type, post_id, comment_id, followee_id, content, is_read, create_time from tb_notification where notification_id = #{notificationId}
mapper.insert: insert into tb_notification (recipient_id, sender_id, type, post_id, comment_id, followee_id, content, is_read, create_time) values (#{recipientId}, #{senderId}, #{type}, #{postId}, #{commentId}, #{followeeId}, #{content}, #{isRead}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_notification WHERE recipient_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
